disclaimer: Illustrative investigative check shipped with the prototype. It is not derived from any verified or suppressed incident, and a match is not evidence of fraud. Set thresholds from your own policy before use.
name: Payment recorded before its approval
description: Flags payments whose recorded approval timestamp is later than the payment date, which is a chronology inconsistency to explain.

graceDays.rationale: Illustrative default of zero days; increase if approvals are routinely back-dated for batching.

conditions.description: Approval is recorded after the payment date plus grace

support.assumption: An approval after release cannot have controlled the release.

benignExplanations: Batch approval entered after an urgent, separately authorised payment
falsePositiveConsiderations: Some systems record approval of the reconciliation, not of the payment
